scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street at night with a large open space and buildings in the distance. The street is empty except for a few people walking in the distance. There are several tall buildings lining the street, including a large white building with blue lettering on top. The street is well-lit by tall street lamps. The ground is made of concrete with a pattern of different colored stones. There are trees and bushes along the sidewalk. A person is sitting on a bench in the distance. The sky is dark. The lighting is bright and clear. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful. }
